description: Orchestrator for the full academic research pipeline: research -> write -> integrity check -> review

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrator for the full academic research pipeline: research -> write -> integrity check -> review
interface.longDescription: Orchestrator for the full academic research pipeline: research -> write -> integrity check -> review -> revise -> re-review -> re-revise -> final integrity check -> finalize. Coordinates deep-research, academic-paper, and academic-paper-reviewer into a seamless 9-stage workflow with mandatory integrity verification, two-stage peer review, and reproducible quality gates. Triggers on: academic pipeline, research to paper, full paper workflow, paper pipeline, end-to-end paper, research-to-publication, complete paper workflow.
